decisions: Model uses GST-inclusive display, 18% GST and a 2% + 18% gateway fee as configurable defaults, so the maths is auditable rather than hidden.
The engine supports an explicit tier ladder as well as a computed one, because most sellers already have store prices and need validation, not a replacement.
Dark-pattern checks follow the CCPA 2023 categories that a text audit can actually detect: false urgency and drip pricing.
Refund language such as 'money-back guarantee' is exempt from the guarantee-claim rule, because a refund policy is required rather than prohibited.
unresolved: Owner approval for final pricing, license and publication.
GST treatment must be confirmed by a CA; the skill does not file or advise.
evidence: ₹1,499 at 18% GST and 2.36% gateway nets ₹1,240.36; break-even CPA matches.
₹2,999 bundle nets ₹2,481.55, a 21% discount against the ₹3,797 individual sum.
Clean offer page audits at 100/100; non-compliant page at 0/100 with GST, urgency and income findings.
